blocking_findings.title: CPU reconstruction dropped the existing RNG replay fix
blocking_findings.evidence: The script constructs parent at line 59, then constructs each terminal model at line 79 without restoring the CPU RNG state, yet requires every one of 1314 tensors to equal parent_state plus the terminal delta at line 82. selected_mask_reference_factory.py installs BoundaryEvidenceReadback after loading official/base state and overlays only the ten candidate_box_refiner tensors from selected_payload. BoundaryEvidenceReadback contains random Linear/attention/face_embedding state; only its output projection is zeroed. These R hidden tensors are not supplied by the terminal delta. The matching already-existing W/inspect_closed_terminals_rng_replay_authorized.py explicitly seeds/captures RNG at lines 59-60 and restores it before each build at line 81.
blocking_findings.consequence: The independent CPU builds generate different uncheckpointed R hidden tensors, so the strict full-state assertion fails although terminal content may be valid. This source version cannot serve as the intended complete CPU reconstruction check.

No model forward or new weight file is needed.
